title: unlearning
press: From the super sexy ‘fantasy daddy’, through the off-kilter ‘hurt it’,   to slo-mo cut ‘doubtful baby’, [unlearning is] a lush and varied release and has us eagerly awaiting what’s next. - DJ Mag
description: My first project explores three phases of a codependent relationship as it unfolds through infatuation, uncertainty, and collapse. It navigates the experience of losing yourself in another person and where that tendency comes from.
coverArtDescription: Madeline gazes at a warped mirror, one arm outstretched, with black and blue tiles behind them

title: Love Song
description: My second single, a cover of folk songwriter Lesley Duncan's 1971 composition 'Love Song' (made popular by Elton John). This is one of my favorite songs to fingerpick on guitar, and I was inspired to do a dance-forward cover.
coverArtDescription: An pixelated representation of Madeline's eye printed on crumpled pink paper

title: CLUB SODA
description: A song about what bubbles beneath the surface of a calm exterior, and the faces we wear in public spaces.
coverArtDescription: A silver can spills purple liquid onto a corregated turqoise plastic surface

title: fantasy daddy remixes
description: Four unique interpretations of 'fantasy daddy' from artists representing Toronto, New York, and Chicago
coverArtDescription: A profile image of Madeline's face dissolves into a pool of swirling orange and purple
